011import paint.shared.objects.Experiment;
012import paint.shared.objects.Project;
013import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
014import paint.shared.validate.ValidationResult;
015
016import java.nio.file.Files;
017import java.nio.file.Path;
018import java.time.Duration;
019import java.time.LocalDateTime;
020import java.util.Arrays;
021import java.util.List;
022import java.util.Locale;
023
024import static paint.generatesquares.calc.GenerateSquaresProcessor.generateSquaresForExperiment;
025import static paint.generatesquares.calc.PlotUtils.exportBackgroundHistogramsToPngs;
026
027import static paint.shared.io.ExperimentDataLoader.loadExperiment;
028import static paint.shared.utils.CsvUtils.concatenateNamedCsvFiles;
029import static paint.shared.utils.Miscellaneous.formatDuration;
030import static paint.shared.validate.ValidationHandler.validateExperiments;
031
032import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV;
033import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.RECORDINGS_CSV;
034import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.TRACKS_CSV;
035import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.SQUARES_CSV;
036
037import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;

039/**
040 * Executes the Generate Squares pipeline in headless mode. This includes
041 * validating experiments, running per-experiment calculations, generating
042 * histogram plots, and producing project-level summary CSVs.
043 */
044public class GenerateSquaresHeadless {
045
046    /**
047     * Runs the Generate Squares workflow for the specified project and list of
048     * experiments. The process includes validation, computation, histogram
049     * export, and final CSV aggregation.
050     *
051     * @param projectPath     the root path of the project
052     * @param experimentNames the experiments to process
053     */
054    public static void run(Path projectPath, List<String> experimentNames)  {
055
056        // --- Early abort check ---
057        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
058            PaintLogger.infof("Generate Squares run aborted before start (user cancelled).");
059            return;
060        }
061
062        // --- Validate input data ---
063        PaintLogger.infof("Validating input data...");
064        ValidationResult validateResult = validateExperiments(
065                projectPath,
066                experimentNames,
067                Arrays.asList(EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV, RECORDINGS_CSV, TRACKS_CSV)
068        );
069        if (!validateResult.isValid()) {
070            for (String line : validateResult.getReport().split("\n")) {
071                PaintLogger.errorf(line);
072            }
073            throw new IllegalStateException("Experiment validation failed.");
074        }
075
076        // --- Log context and configuration. show what we are going to do ---
077        logContextAndConfiguration(projectPath, experimentNames);
078        LocalDateTime start = LocalDateTime.now();
079
080        // --- Prepare project container ---
081        Project project = new Project();
082        project.setProjectRootPath(projectPath);
083        project.setExperimentNames(experimentNames);
084        GenerateSquaresConfig generateSquaresConfig = new GenerateSquaresConfig();  // Reads the config via PaintConfig
085        project.setGenerateSquaresConfig(generateSquaresConfig);
086
087        if (generateSquaresConfig.isWholeScreen()) {
088            PaintLogger.warnf("Grid is 1x1 (whole screen): Min Required Density Ratio set to %s, "
089                                      + "Neighbour Mode to %s and Max Allowable Variability to %.0f (no limit); "
090                                      + "the values in the configuration file are ignored.",
091                              GenerateSquaresConfig.WHOLE_SCREEN_MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO,
092                              GenerateSquaresConfig.WHOLE_SCREEN_NEIGHBOUR_MODE,
093                              GenerateSquaresConfig.WHOLE_SCREEN_MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY);
094        }
095
096        // -- See if we should generate background plots ---
097        boolean showPlots = generateSquaresConfig.isBackgroundPlots();
098
099        // --- Run each experiment ---
100        for (String experimentName : experimentNames) {
101
102            if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
103                PaintLogger.infof("Generate Squares run stopped early (user cancelled).");
104                return;
105            }
106
107            PaintLogger.infof("Running Generate Squares for experiment: %s", experimentName);
108
109            try {
110                generateSquaresForExperiment(project, experimentName);
111            } catch (Exception e) {
112                PaintLogger.errorf("Error processing experiment %s: %s", experimentName, e.getMessage());
113                continue;
114            }
115
116            // --- Generate background histogram plots, if enabled ---
117            if (showPlots) {
118                try {
119                    Experiment experiment = loadExperiment(
120                            projectPath,
121                            experimentName,
122                            true,   // Load Squares
123                            false   // Skip Tracks
124                    );
125
126                    Path experimentPath = projectPath.resolve(experimentName);
127                    Path outPath        = experimentPath.resolve("Output");
128                    Files.createDirectories(outPath);
129
130                    exportBackgroundHistogramsToPngs(
131                            experiment,
132                            experimentPath);
133
134                } catch (Exception e) {
135                    PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to export histograms for %s: %s",
136                                       experimentName, e.getMessage());
137                }
138            }
139        }
140
141        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
142            PaintLogger.infof("Cancelled before concatenating project-level CSVs.");
143            return;
144        }
145
146        // --- Concatenate project-level CSVs ---
147        try {
148            PaintLogger.infof("Creating project-level summary files...");
149
150            PaintLogger.infof("   Creating %s", projectPath.resolve(SQUARES_CSV));
151            concatenateNamedCsvFiles(projectPath, SQUARES_CSV, experimentNames);
152
153            PaintLogger.infof("   Creating %s", projectPath.resolve(RECORDINGS_CSV));
154            concatenateNamedCsvFiles(projectPath, RECORDINGS_CSV, experimentNames);
155
156            PaintLogger.infof("   Creating %s", projectPath.resolve(EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV));
157            concatenateNamedCsvFiles(projectPath, EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV, experimentNames);
158
159            PaintLogger.infof("   Creating %s", projectPath.resolve(TRACKS_CSV));
160            concatenateNamedCsvFiles(projectPath, TRACKS_CSV, experimentNames);
161        } catch (Exception e) {
162            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to concatenate CSVs: %s", e.getMessage());
163        }
164
165        PaintLogger.blankline();
166
167        Duration duration = Duration.between(start, LocalDateTime.now());
168        PaintLogger.infof("Finished Generate Squares for all experiments in %s",
169                          formatDuration(duration));
170    }
171
172    /**
173     * Logs project and configuration context before execution begins, including
174     * selected experiments and all relevant parameter settings.
175     */
176    private static void logContextAndConfiguration(Path projectPath, List<String> experimentNames) {
177
178        // Read through the typed config rather than re-reading each key with its own inline
179        // default: the defaults belong in one place, and the grid side has one definition.
180        GenerateSquaresConfig config = new GenerateSquaresConfig();
181
182        int    nSquares   = config.getNumberOfSquaresInRecording();
183        int    side       = config.getGridSize();
184        int    minTracks  = config.getMinTracksToCalculateTau();
185        double minRSq     = config.getMinRequiredRSquared();
186        double minDensity = config.getMinRequiredDensityRatio();
187        double maxVar     = config.getMaxAllowableVariability();
188
189        String formattedExperiments;
190        if (experimentNames.isEmpty()) {
191            formattedExperiments = "                   (none selected — please verify selection)";
192        } else {
193            final int MAX_WIDTH = 100;
194            final String INDENT = "                   ";
195
196            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("  "); // the first line has only 2 leading spaces
197            int currentLineLength = 2;
198            int effectiveMaxWidthFirstLine = MAX_WIDTH - (INDENT.length() - 2);
199
200            for (int i = 0; i < experimentNames.size(); i++) {
201                String exp = experimentNames.get(i);
202                int tokenLength = exp.length() + (i < experimentNames.size() - 1 ? 2 : 0);
203
204                // use narrower limit for first line, normal for later lines
205                int limit = (sb.indexOf("\n") == -1) ? effectiveMaxWidthFirstLine : MAX_WIDTH;
206
207                if (currentLineLength + tokenLength > limit) {
208                    sb.append("\n").append(INDENT);
209                    currentLineLength = INDENT.length();
210                }
211
212                sb.append(exp);
213                currentLineLength += exp.length();
214
215                if (i < experimentNames.size() - 1) {
216                    sb.append(", ");
217                    currentLineLength += 2;
218                }
219            }
220
221            formattedExperiments = sb.toString();
222        }
223
224        PaintLogger.doc(GENERATE_SQUARES, Arrays.asList(
225                "Starting Generate Squares analysis for project: " + projectPath.getFileName(),
226                "",
227                "Selected experiments:",
228                formattedExperiments,
229                "",
230                "Using parameters:",
231                String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "  • Grid size:                 %dx%d (%d squares)", side, side, nSquares),
232                String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "  • Minimum tracks per square: %d",                 minTracks),
233                String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "  • Minimum R²:                %.2f",               minRSq),
234                String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "  • Minimum density ratio:     %.1f",               minDensity),
235                String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "  • Maximum variability:       %.1f",               maxVar),
236                "",
237                "Each recording will be divided into spatial squares, and per-square track statistics will be calculated.",
238                "Results will be prepared per experiment, and squares and tracks files updated.",
239                "",
240                "The results will then be compiled into project-level files:",
241                String.format("  • %s", SQUARES_CSV),
242                String.format("  • %s (with updated Square Number and Label Number fields)", TRACKS_CSV),
243                String.format("  • %s", RECORDINGS_CSV),
244                String.format("  • %s", EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV)
245        ));
246    }
247}
